items.title: Russia alleges overnight strikes hit Ukrainian drone and aircraft-engine plants
items.summary: Russian military statements allege that overnight strikes hit two Kyiv facilities involved in attack-drone production, Techno-Links and Ukrplastic, as well as the Motor Sich and Ivchenko-Progress aircraft-engine plants in Zaporizhzhia. The reported hits, facilities' military roles and extent of any damage have not been independently verified.
